stem:
A capacitor of capacitance *C* and a resistor of resistance *R* are connected as shown in Fig. 6.1.

[[fig:f1]]

Initially, the capacitor is charged and the switch is open.

The switch is closed at time *t* = 0.

Fig. 6.2 and Fig. 6.3 show, respectively, the variations with *t* of the charge *Q* on the capacitor and the potential difference (p.d.) *V* across the resistor.

[[fig:f2]]

[[fig:f3]]

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain the shape of the line in Fig. 6.3 representing the variation of *V* with *t*.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Use Fig. 6.2 to show that the time constant of the circuit in Fig. 6.1 is 5.5 s.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.lead: Use Fig. 6.2, Fig. 6.3 and the information in (b) to determine:

figures.caption: Fig. 6.1
figures.alt: A circuit with a capacitor labelled C, a resistor labelled R and an open switch connected in a loop.

figures.caption: Fig. 6.2
figures.alt: A graph of charge Q against time t showing a decreasing curve that approaches zero.

figures.caption: Fig. 6.3
figures.alt: A graph of potential difference V against time t showing a decreasing curve that approaches zero.
